**paths.scripts scope question (from #1919) — answered:** one shared setting, no daemon-specific variant.

The daemon resolves `paths.scripts` from the same configuration file and environment it was started with (`internal/daemon` `execFileResolver` → `internal/scriptresolve.Resolver{Configured: paths.scripts}`), exactly as the CLI does. A daemon-specific list would make the same script name resolve differently depending on who was asked — the divergence this issue exists to remove. Implementation in progress on branch `queue/3202-2168-script-resolution` (queue task 3202).

- **Expectation:** PR #2586 awaiting CI + Codex review disposition, then merge and close this issue

**Agent note — triage task 7863 (opencode execution lane)**

Verified at current main (`origin/main` = c2283a5721):

- **Issue still live.** `resolveScript` remains CLI-private (`pkgs/mcpx/internal/cli/scripts.go:264`); no `internal/scriptresolve` shared package exists on main. Daemon `routes_exec.go` passes `file` straight to `os.ReadFile` (line ~368) — no search-path name resolution, miss names no directories. `docs/exec.md` documents resolve-locally-send-text only; no `--remote-file`/`file:` form.
- **Ownership blocker resolved.** Canonical PR #2586 (branch `queue/3202-2168-script-resolution` @ 8501d1a5a, author dezren39) was **CLOSED unmerged 2026-11-08** (`mergedAt: null`, `mergeCommit: null`; `basic: test` FAILURE, proxy-port fallback + spec parity SUCCESS). Prior hard-stop ("Drew-owned, no competing PR") no longer applies. The branch still exists remotely (589 insertions across 10 files incl. `internal/scriptresolve/`) and is a valid reference/rebase base — but the `basic: test` failure that blocked it must be fixed in any revival.
- **Fix path scoped:** extract `resolveScript` → shared package callable from `internal/execsvc`; daemon `/v1/exec` resolves bare names on the same search path (miss errors naming every directory searched); CLI `--remote-file`/`file:` form; exec flags on daemon-resolved runs carried or refused; `docs/exec.md`; daemon-resolution tests mirroring CLI `resolveScript` tests in `pkgs/mcpx` CI (`go test ./...`).
- **No new blockers.** Next step is an implementation task (fresh branch from current main, reusing #2586 as reference), not further triage.
